quick.gap_to_merge: the nightly group's files run on main pushes and nightly, not per pull request; merge-only JOBS (the macOS leg) differ otherwise

app.gap_to_merge: none: app-verify and both app CI jobs run this group after app-build in the app environment

nightly.gap_to_merge: none: full runs these files on every main push, and the scheduled CI run runs full nightly

cadence.ruling: owner 2026-08-28 (development hub knowledge/decision-records.md, ): nothing per commit; the quick/CI-PR group before handing to review; the full suite ONCE when ready to merge, after the accept; CI is a two-platform double-check, not a different cadence
cadence.before-review: quick (pixi run verify-quick; what CI runs on a pull request)
cadence.ready-to-merge: full, once (pixi run verify-full == pixi run verify; the mount verify and the x-ship gate; what CI runs on merge)

note: : quick and full name WHEN verification runs; app names the Qt environment required by integration/app, not another cadence. Core tasks retain their prior selections outside integration/app; app-verify and both app CI jobs execute group-app after app-build. Both verify cadences retain all app cases, and each platform's combined full core/app jobs cover the complete collection. Default pytest collection retains every tier for the runtime inventory. Groups name paths, never predicates over runtime; edi declares no fitting corpus. The per-tier audit refuses marker-based deselection.

local_gap_to_merge.statement: the review-time quick run (pixi run verify-quick) leaves out the nightly group's three files, which spend minutes building a native host; the merge-time full run and CI on main pushes and nightly run them
local_gap_to_merge.cost: three system files, about 15 minutes of host builds, move from review time to merge time and the nightly run
